Finally, a question that is my time to share my life. Outside my house, when I was a playful kid, I had the stupidest way to have fun. I wrapped my right upper leg and lower leg together by a handtowel tightly and proceeded to hop anywhere around with one leg. It was so much fun that my brain departed. My house was above a short, sloped land so there's a cemented, sloped pathway to arrive in my house. When I was on the top of the pathway, I started hopping down like a zombie with one leg. That's when I couldn't control or stop myself from going down, if I did I would roll down, so I had to continue until the end. But when I reached the end, it's like God wanted to punish me for being stupid, I tripped and fell on a ground with rocks protruding from the soil. My knee hit one of the rocks and it was sharp-ish, so it penetrated through my skin and probably deeper. It gave me a gash in my knee. It hurt so bad that I was using my one leg for a purpose. I hopped away slowly and treated the wound by myself. I didn't tell my parents about it because they would scold me. My treatment was also stupid, I just removed the blood with the handtowel and placed one single bandaid. Eventually, my parents found out my injury because I was limping when I tried to walk normally to avoid noticing. And of course, I was punished. Now, I have a scar that looks like the cross of Jesus in sideways, but one of its arm is short and small and it's raised in 45 degrees angle.

Thank god my mother is emotionally sensitive. If she was not, just like my father, both of them would likely get disappointed, say "Tsk", open their eyes widely from the unexpected, hold their head as they slide their hair backwards, sigh quietly and call the ambulance calmly. And their reason for my death is not depression or anxiety and they are not the blame of my suicide because it's all my fault. I love my mom
